The text is markup source, so `*`, `[` and a mention tag mint real marks; escape a literal one with a backslash. The cap is 8000 UTF-16 code units, where one emoji can cost two or more. Attachments are object ids, at most 32, and each one's kind is taken from the target's layout. In a discussion the text is stored as blocks, one per line; a line of exactly --- is a divider.
